name: Cauliflower

low.description: Small serving that may be tolerated

high.description: High in mannitol, likely to trigger symptoms

siboNotes: Cauliflower is higher in FODMAPs than most vegetables and should be limited or avoided during elimination. Some people may tolerate a 3/4 cup serving, but many with SIBO find it problematic. Use broccoli florets as an alternative.
preparationTips: If attempting, start with very small portions
Often used as rice substitute but portions must be watched
